cds.title: Commonwealth University of Pennsylvania Common Data Set 2025-2026 (web page)

stats.notes: CDS covers all campuses of the merged university (Bloomsburg, Lock Haven, Mansfield); figures are not split by campus. Fall 2025 first-year class. The C1 residency split reports 13 international applicants, all 13 admitted and all 13 enrolled. Undergrad enrollment is the B1 'Total Undergraduates' column (9,488, incl. non-degree-seeking; nonresident 58). C6 says it is not an open-admission school; no early decision or early action. Only about a quarter of enrolled students submitted SAT scores, so the score percentiles describe that subgroup.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2026-27; the CDS says final 2026-27 costs were due about Aug 1, 2026). Out-of-state and international tuition are the same ($20,846). CDS H6: institutional need-based aid is available to nonresidents (31 received it, avg $10,413) and non-need-based aid is marked 'No', but the university's scholarship page lists GPA-based merit scholarships for international students (see cycle file).
